scope: Fixed globally commuting idempotent factors; public spectral list and polynomial-size key-selected decision-tree correctness filter.
limitations: Not an attack on arbitrary GSW bootstrapping. The semantic list implication requires correctness for the constructed public-list-dependent right-CMux tree; correctness only on a narrower refresh family does not imply that premise.

native_witnesses.limitations: Algebraic witness only; factors are not canonical digits, not short, and not sampled by a secure control generator.
